purpose: Define the user and system library roots used for discovery of UserModules, MCP, tools and web resources without making physical location the semantic identity of discovered artifacts.

topics.name: Library Roots
topics.purpose: Define the user and system library roots used for discovery of UserModules, MCP, tools and web resources without making physical location the semantic identity of discovered artifacts.

semantics.system_rule: System library follows the same explicit discovery/source-role principles as user library.
semantics.identity_rule: Library path is a physical/discovery binding and never the canonical semantic identity.
semantics.precedence_rule: User/system precedence or override behavior must be explicit and never inferred solely from path order.
semantics.availability_rule: Artifact presence in a library does not imply enabled/running runtime state.
semantics.authority_rule: Library visibility does not grant install/load/execute authority.

invariants.rule: Library discovery and installation are explicit source/package lifecycle semantics; filesystem presence, discovery order or installation never silently changes canonical identity, enables dependencies or activates runtime effects.

hard_gates.condition: library path used as semantic identity
user/system conflict resolved only by path order

references.purpose: Library artifacts are explicit source/package records.
